title: gcz.19 fix: end_offset=le is minimal and correct
description: The single-line fix 'end_offset = le;' before 'break;' in handle_block() is the minimal correct change. It advances pos past the bad line without disturbing any other invariant. The accompanying comment explains both the problem (end_offset stays at input.len()) and the fix (advance to le). A contributor might suggest 'just continue the loop instead of breaking' — but that would change the 'stop at first decode error' semantic that decode() also uses, so breaking is correct. The fix matches decode() behavior exactly: partial data up to the error, is_truncated=true.
close_reason: Confirmed: no code change needed. Existing implementation is correct per review analysis.
